rankedLeadSummary: 1. Ital Tek — Kill Switch: guitar-derived pounding kicks, static-charged chords and expectation-resetting pauses.
2. Batu & Donato Dozzy — Exhale: loose syncopation and sub punctuation turning into a techno stepper.
3. Shed — The Bot: slow atmospheric syncopation whose beat arrives only after four minutes.
4. Batu & Donato Dozzy — Swarm: loose percussion and synth motion disintegrating toward near-emptiness.
5. Ital Tek — Undertow: a harsh rhythm searching for a groove without settling.
6. Shed — Final Experiment: irregular palpitations resistant to easy bodily mapping.
7. Batu & Donato Dozzy — Off Axis: synth impulses organised around documented tension and release.
8. Ital Tek — Misted: guitar used as the driving device in a rare four-to-the-floor construction.
9. Shed — Keep Time: heavy concise club momentum inside an otherwise nonlinear album.
